jobs.title: Web Development Intern
jobs.description:
Company Description
Laneway is a next-generation business management consulting company focused on driving growth through consulting, technology, and media services. The organization partners with founders, startups, and established enterprises to turn bold ideas into scalable solutions using business insights, creative thinking, and technology-driven execution. Core services include strategic business consulting, technology support for MVPs and AI-powered digital products, and media and marketing services that boost visibility and brand influence. Founded and led by the next generation of business leaders, Laneway aims to solve modern business challenges and act as a long-term growth partner and venture platform. The team is committed to building, designing, and growing alongside clients while creating enduring value for all stakeholders.
Role Description
The Web Development Intern role is a remote internship focused on supporting the design, development, and maintenance of web applications and digital products. Day-to-day tasks include assisting with front-end and back-end development, implementing responsive user interfaces, and collaborating with designers and consultants to translate business requirements into technical solutions. The intern will help troubleshoot issues, perform basic testing, and contribute to documentation for web projects. This role also involves participating in team meetings, communicating progress clearly, and learning best practices in modern web development within a consulting and startup-oriented environment.
Qualifications

Candidates should possess skills in Front-End Development and Web Design, including familiarity with HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and responsive design principles.
Candidates should possess skills in Back-End Web Development, such as working with server-side technologies, APIs, and databases.
Candidates should possess core Web Development skills, including understanding of web architecture, version control (e.g., Git), and basic debugging.
Candidates should possess strong Communication skills, including the ability to collaborate in remote teams and present technical concepts clearly.
Relevant qualifications include ongoing or completed studies in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field.
Additional beneficial skills include familiarity with modern frameworks (e.g., React, Node.js), an interest in startups and consulting, and a proactive approach to learning new technologies.
